summary: AUDIT run of ECP Project Management & Lead Tracking. Executed 31/31 backend pytest cases (20 prior + 11 new audit-focused). All PASS. Verified: (1) spec-D change — OWNER is now 403 on POST /api/leads/{id}/action for ALL 5 actions (YES/NO/FOLLOW_UP/SITE_VISIT/ESCALATION); MANAGER also 403; only LEAD may decide. (2) Dispatch continuity — after start-dispatch with FIRST=CONFIRMED, patching FIRST back to PENDING does NOT stop dispatch (dispatch_started stays true, derived remains DISPATCH_IN_PROCESS). (3) Financing NO->YES after REGISTRATION_1 does not regress stage; loan tasks become applicable in-place; RBAC enforced (REGISTRATION/ACCOUNTS/DISPATCH/INSTALLATION 403; LEAD/MANAGER/OWNER 200). (4) Users & PUT /sla owner-only — every non-OWNER role (incl. MANAGER) 403. (5) Task RBAC — REGISTRATION cannot complete an ACCOUNTS_1 task (403). (6) Escalations MANAGER 403 for list and return. (7) Site visits — INSTALLATION cannot complete a visit assigned to another installer (403); assignee can. (8) Auth hardening — 9 protected endpoints return 401 without token. Full pipeline REGISTRATION_1→ACCOUNTS_1→DISPATCH(payment gate + task-before-start gate + duplicate FIRST rejected)→INSTALLATION→NET_METERING→REGISTRATION_2→ACCOUNTS_2→COMPLETED (no FINAL required) still passes. Closure RBAC/OTHER-remarks/re-close-block, LOST-reopen OWNER-only, follow-up past-date rejection, escalation owner-remarks-mandatory all confirmed. Frontend smoke: Owner and Lead login work; dashboards render role-specific counters correctly (Owner sees Leads/ECP/Payments panels; Lead sees only My Lead Queue + Leads/ECP nav — Users/SLA/Escalations/Payments/Site Visits hidden). Welcome toast shown; logout via localStorage works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still a single ~1050 line file. As Phase 2 grows, split into routers (auth/leads/ecps/payments/dashboard) for maintainability.

_advance_stage on final step keeps current_stage='ACCOUNTS_2' and sets status=COMPLETED. Works correctly but a bit surprising when reading the record; consider explicit current_stage='COMPLETED' to simplify downstream filtering.
list_leads returns [] for ACCOUNTS/DISPATCH/INSTALLATION/REGISTRATION. Correct per spec (they see ECPs only), but confirmed OK; no lead-level PII leaks.
No pagination on list endpoints; .to_list(3000/5000) will truncate silently at scale — fine for V1.
Payment PATCH does not re-check whether it is FIRST/FINAL uniqueness (patching only updates fields, not type — good, cannot violate uniqueness).

get_lead has no explicit role restriction — non-LEAD/OWNER/MANAGER can still GET /api/leads/{id} by id-guessing. Currently _lead_bundle allows any authenticated user. Consider restricting to lead_visible_roles + ACCOUNTS (for payment context) or add a scoping check. Low severity because IDs are UUIDs and endpoint isn't linked in UI for those roles.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for smoke flows (login for OWNER & LEAD, dashboards render, nav scoped per role)
